mock filesystem and git operations. utils/lazy_loader.py is a module-level
lazy import utility - test import mechanics.

anti_patterns.dont: add tests that depend on filesystem state or network
anti_patterns.instead: mock I/O using unittest.mock or pytest tmp_path fixture
anti_patterns.why: CI environments vary and network tests are flaky

anti_patterns.instead: test via public methods and documented interfaces only
anti_patterns.why: private APIs can change without notice, breaking tests

preserves.behavior: All existing tests continue to pass
